qrave.name: QRAVE / ServeQ

metrics.sync_latency: <200ms order-to-kitchen transmission latency using WebSocket protocols
metrics.network_traffic_reduction: Reduced backend request traffic by 90% by replacing HTTP polling with Supabase Postgres WAL real-time channels
metrics.concurrency_handling: Stabilized API response times at <250ms during load testing simulation of up to 5,000 concurrent user sessions

full_stack: Architected a scalable, multi-tenant contactless ordering SaaS platform using **React 19, Node.js, Express, and Supabase (PostgreSQL)**, supporting high-concurrency restaurant operations.
Designed an automated split-payment distribution workflow using **Razorpay Route API**, routing merchant payouts with **HMAC-SHA256** cryptographic signature verification.
Eliminated database polling bottlenecks by replacing HTTP polling with **Supabase Real-time WebSocket channels** (listening to PostgreSQL WAL), reducing network traffic by 90%.
Engineered an asynchronous transaction queue using **p-queue** to throttle outbound API calls (max concurrency 15), preventing payment processor rate limits and memory spikes.
backend_sde: Built a high-performance **Node.js/Express REST API** with Helmet security headers, stateless JWT validation, layered rate-limiting, and structured error boundaries.
Engineered relational database schemas in **PostgreSQL** with ACID-compliant transaction logs, foreign key constraints, and indexing across multi-tenant restaurant and order tables.
Designed an asynchronous queuing mechanism with **p-queue** to throttle outbound payment gateway operations, stabilizing CPU and memory utilization during traffic surges.
Integrated **Supabase WebSocket replication** directly from PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Logs (WAL) to broadcast live orders to kitchen dashboards in under 200ms.
high_concurrency_fintech: Implemented split-payment routing and automated vendor commission splits via **Razorpay Route API** secured with HMAC-SHA256 webhook validation.
Prevented payment gateway rate limits (HTTP 429) during peak traffic spikes by deploying an in-memory priority queue using **p-queue** (concurrency ceiling of 15).
Engineered resilient real-time state synchronization via custom reconnection hooks (**useSupabaseChannelReconnect**), maintaining WebSocket sync through network dropouts.

metrics.ood_rejection_rate: >99% True Rejection Rate (TRR) on non-agricultural images using YOLOv8n Out-Of-Distribution gatekeeper

Implemented **YOLOv8n** as an Out-of-Distribution (OOD) visual gatekeeper to filter non-agricultural inputs, achieving a **>99% True Rejection Rate** to prevent hallucinations.

Leveraged **Llama-3 LLMs via Groq API** to fuse visual disease classifications with live **OpenWeatherMap API** climate data, generating structured preventive treatment plans.

Engineered a multi-tiered fault-tolerance fallback chain (**MobileNetV2 $->$ ResNet50 $->$ Groq Vision API**), ensuring near-100% diagnostic uptime under model errors.
Implemented strict upload security using **Werkzeug** sanitization and optimized server response pipelines to achieve **3.4s end-to-end processing latency**.
Built a localized text-to-speech audio synthesis pipeline using **deep-translator, gTTS, and FFmpeg**, streaming multilingual audio advisories directly to client browsers.
full_stack_ai: Developed a responsive multi-modal web platform using **Flask, JavaScript, HTML5 Geolocation, and Web Speech API**, enabling hands-free voice dictation for rural users.
Built end-to-end computer vision diagnostic workflows with **PyTorch and OpenCV**, achieving **94.2% accuracy** across 38 plant pathology classes.
Constructed dynamic multi-language translation and audio delivery pipelines (**deep-translator + gTTS**), converting LLM diagnoses into regional voice advisories.
